p.font: The file to import must contain the following columns with these names:

li.font: product's default code or barcode. This field is required and must be previously created in Odoo.
location where the product should be stored. This field is required and must be previously created in Odoo.
sets the minimum quantity of product in our warehouse. If not specified default will be 0.
sets the maximum quantity of product in our warehouse. If not specified default will be 0.
order the products only in batches for certain quantities. If not specified default will be 0.
number of days after the orderpoint is triggered to receive the products or to order to the vendor. If not specified default will be 0
type lead: 'net' for 'Day(s) to get the products' and 'supplier' for 'Day(s) to purchase'. This field is required.

p.font: Important notes: The lines that contain an error in any of their fields will not be imported. If a orderpoint rule with the combination of location_id and product_id already exists in the system, it will be updated.
If you wish you can add fields setting the name of the field as the column name. To see the name of the fields you must activate developer mode from the Settings/Activate developer mode menu.
